Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Evidence of the applicable examination fee and any renewed topic or supervisor request required by the current faculty route. The amount and payment channel are not frozen. Authority: C1, C2, C4–C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Faculty or department secretariat verifies current status, credited payment and any renewed request. Retain the receipt, credited-status evidence and written confirmation in the restricted dossier.
Recommended response: Mark NOT APPLICABLE for an ordinary current-cohort candidate. If triggered and missing, registration is not ready; do not infer payment from initiation of a transaction.

Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Expanded education and civil-status dossier plus fee evidence. Bachelor’s and master’s lists differ. Certification or conformity requirements must follow the regulation and current clarification. Authority: C1, C2, C6 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Secretariat verifies the complete route-specific dossier. Retain the submitted inventory and confirmation. Present originals where the current certification route requires them.
Recommended response: Known control risk: C1 requires certified or legalised copies for specified bachelor’s records, while C6 is less precise. Mark CONFLICT rather than silently accepting a weaker standard.

Trigger: Temporary international mobility or double degree
Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Endorsement from the competent Erasmus+ structure for access to the supplementary session when the official condition is met. Authority: C1, C2 and, for the discovered August 2026 announcements, C10–C11. Target payload verification remains mandatory.
Verifier and recommended retention: The competent mobility office confirms status; the faculty verifies the endorsed registration route. Retain the endorsed application and evidence of late host-university record transmission.
Recommended response: Without the status endorsement, do not claim eligibility for the supplementary route. Use the ordinary later session unless competent written authority determines otherwise.

Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Institutional protocol and approvals, route equivalence, co-supervision or ASE supervisor requirement and the expanded dossier specified by the applicable regulation. Authority: C1 or C2.
Verifier and recommended retention: Both institutions and the designated ASE authorities act within the approved protocol. Retain the protocol, approvals, supervisor record and complete candidate dossier separately from the scientific manuscript.
Recommended response: This is not an ordinary previous-cohort case. Missing institutional authority blocks the route before scientific or administrative closeout.

Trigger: Electronic identity card or legal-name difference
Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Residence evidence where required for an electronic identity card and civil-status evidence where the submitted name differs from the education record. Authority: current faculty notice, including C6 or C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Secretariat verifies identity consistency under the current instructions. Retain only the restricted submitted copy and a checklist record; avoid unnecessary duplication.
Recommended response: Do not “correct” names independently across forms. Resolve the controlling identity string and required evidence before submission.

Trigger: Loss of institutional account or alternative channel
Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Obtain and retain the current authorised alternative channel or account-recovery instruction. Do not use an address remembered from a previous session. Authority: C4 or C5 and the current notice.
Verifier and recommended retention: The competent faculty or technical service confirms the route. Retain the written instruction, sent-item evidence and receipt.
Recommended response: Do not treat technical inability as automatic deadline extension. Escalate before the deadline and preserve the evidence trail.

Additional record or evidence: Conditional. Payment evidence is required for the status defined by the current regulation, including previous cohorts and additional-year candidates. The applicable amount can change. Authority: C1, C2 and current session sources.
Verifier and recommended retention: ASE records the payment only when credited under the controlling rule; the secretariat verifies the evidence. Retain receipt, transaction reference and credited-status confirmation where available.
Recommended response: A payment instruction, pending transaction or screenshot without route identity is insufficient. Missing credited evidence reopens administrative readiness.
